featured_reviews.review_text:

I recently hosted an event at Talisman Banquet, and I must say, it was an extraordinary experience. The venue is absolutely stunning, with its modern yet elegant interiors that add a touch of luxury to any occasion. The spacious halls are beautifully designed, providing the perfect setting for both intimate gatherings and large celebrations.

The staff at Talisman Banquet deserve a special mention. From the initial booking to the day of the event, their professionalism and attention to detail were remarkable. They were incredibly accommodating, ensuring that every aspect of the event went smoothly. The food was another highlight—delicious, diverse, and served impeccably, leaving all the guests raving about the menu.

The management team, led by [Manager’s Name, if known], was always available to address any queries and went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. The parking arrangements, lighting, and overall ambiance were top-notch, creating a seamless experience for everyone.

If you’re looking for a venue that combines elegance, excellent service, and great food, I highly recommend Talisman Banquet. It made my special day truly unforgettable!

featured_reviews.name: Shams sayed
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience at Babji Caterers on the 25th Ramzan night.
We first ordered Butter Garlic Seekh, but the taste was completely off. The menu combination felt forced and the flavors were not in sync at all.
Then we ordered a Chicken Roll and Chicken Zafrani Tikka (yellow sauce dipped). The tikka had a very distinct beef-like texture, smell, and taste. When we asked the waiter, he insisted it was chicken, but honestly it did not taste like chicken at all. The chicken roll was just okish, nothing special.
Lastly, we ordered plain seekh, thinking at least that would be good. But surprisingly, even that didn’t taste good. Seekh is something that usually tastes amazing everywhere, but this is the first time I didn’t like seekh anywhere.
The place is overpriced, seating is just average, and the food quality doesn’t justify the price. Instead of spending here, you can easily go to a proper restaurant, sit comfortably, and have much tastier food for the same price.
₹350 for a seekh in Bhatiyar Khana feels like full-on loot.
Not recommended. Save your money.

featured_reviews.name: Safiya
featured_reviews.review_text: I visited on 1 march 2026 at this place.Food is mostly overpriced. Seekh kabab price is Rs 250/- for 2 piece, which is not worth more than 100rs. Not recommended this place, there are many place where we can get this items of their menu at much lesser and reasonable rates.

featured_reviews.name: M K
featured_reviews.review_text:
Babji, Byculla, Mumbai, Sitafalwadi Road Babji in Byculla is a must-see if you're an avid foodie! Especially during their Ramazan setup for iftaari, we enjoyed an amazing meal. Despite having a small menu, every meal is really amazing.
The evening's highlight was without a doubt the **Fish Masala Fry**, which we began with. The fish was melt-in-your-mouth, well-seasoned, and cooked to perfection.
In addition, the **Gurda Masala, Bheja Masala, Nalli Bihari, and Chicken Barra** were expertly prepared and bursting with flavor. With its rich, fragrant spices and succulent, juicy meat, each dish was a perfect example of real Mughlai and North Indian cooking.
In addition to the main courses, we sampled the **Keema, Seekh, Bheja, and Naan Sandwich**, which was incredibly flavorful in every mouthful. The meat of the **Nihari** was exceptionally delicate and perfectly slow-cooked, making it stand out.
We had **Jalebi, Kunafa, and Malpuwa** for sweets, and they were all delicious. Our lunch was perfectly concluded with the **Kunafa**, which was specifically created by the kind and hospitable host.
The texture and sweetness were perfectly balanced!
Excellent service, food quality, and seating arrangements were all provided. To ensure we had the greatest experience, the staff was amiable and considerate.
We felt completely at home thanks to the gracious welcome. All things considered, Babji is a secret treasure for lovers of hearty, tasty cuisine.
This establishment will satisfy your cravings for meats, grills, or rich desserts. Highly recommended, especially the **Kunafa** and **Fish Masala Fry**! I'm looking forward to returning soon.

Recently, I visited Aden Banquet in Dongri, Mazagon, for a small celebration. The hall is compact and ideal for events with around 100 guests. It’s a good choice for intimate gatherings like birthday parties or small family functions.

The ambiance is simple yet pleasant, but since everything is in one hall—including the seating area, buffet, and washroom—it does feel a bit congested. Despite being small, the space is well-maintained and serves its purpose for smaller-scale events.

Overall, Aden Banquet is a decent option for those looking for a budget-friendly and cozy venue in the area. However, the limited space might not be suitable for larger or more elaborate celebrations.
